[RLOW.3.6.1] A `logical` schema's identity key is the set of slots its author
marks `key` ([LFAC.1.7]); every other slot is marked `mutable`, and there is no
default ([LGRA.5.10]). The compiler records each slot's role in the
`identity_role` field of its `Slot` atom (`proto/slot.proto#Slot`).
